paramInfo.bow.dynamics: Bow speed and bow–bridge distance together, as players do it (mod wheel, CC 11). Velocity adds to it per note.
paramInfo.bow.pressure: Bow force relative to the playable window. Low: airy, surface sound. High: crunch and growl. Aftertouch adds to it.
paramInfo.bow.contact: Where the bow meets the string: over the fingerboard (dark, soft) to near the bridge (glassy). CC 74.
paramInfo.bow.bite: How hard notes start: higher means a faster bow acceleration and a stronger accent on loud notes.
paramInfo.bow.change: Time for the bow to reverse when a new detached note starts.
paramInfo.bow.legato: On: overlapping keys slur (same bow, the finger changes). Off: every note changes bow.
paramInfo.bow.friction: Thermal: rosin friction set by contact temperature (Woodhouse). Classic: a friction curve with hysteresis.
paramInfo.finger.intonation: How much the player corrects the pitch drop that heavy bowing causes on stopped notes. Open strings can't be corrected.
paramInfo.out.mode: Library Mic: bridge force through a CC0 response measured from a solo-violin recording (body, mics and room). Pickup: the raw bridge force.
